Messages.Author: Calliste
Messages.Body:
I suppose this has the same resolution as using Temptation on a
minion, enter combat with it and then taking control of said minion
during combat. It causes an immediate combat ends, since there cannot
be combats between minions controlled by the same Methuselah.

But it never hurts to check.

Methuselah 1's Minion A plays Entrancement at superior level on Ally B
(belonging to Methuselah 2). Ally B attempts to block. Minion C
(Methuselah 1's) plays Siren's Lure at superior Melpominee, and the
action resolves.

At this point, Methuselah 1 controls Ally B and Minion C. A combat is
queued between them by Siren's Lure card text.

But combat cannot occur between two minions controlled by the same
Methuselah, so the combat fizzles. Is this correct?

Siren's Lure
[cel] This vampire burns 2 blood to get +1 stealth.
[mel] Only usable by an untapped ready vampire other than the acting
minion when a minion attempts to block. That minion cannot block this
action. Tap this vampire and that minion. Once the action resolves,
this vampire enters combat with that minion.
[MEL] As above, but do not tap this modifying vampire.
